transcript.text: Hi Elena and Marcus, thanks for joining this check-in. As we work toward closing this case, I want to make sure we capture a working agreement that accurately reflects how information will move between you two each week going forward. To do that properly, I need each of you to share any concrete operating constraints or prior promises you've made to each other about the practical arrangements for your weekly information transfers. This is the formal case-record disclosure step, so anything that should govern your ongoing work needs to be put on the record now. Let's start with you, Elena -- what constraints or prior promises should I be aware of?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I have a concrete operating constraint I should put on the record: direct messages after 18:00 are not allowed for me. If something urgent comes up after that time, it needs to go to the shared project channel so I can respond during my agreed working hours. I haven't raised this before because I expected the mediation to focus only on the handoff dispute, but since you're asking about concrete operating constraints for our ongoing work, this is one that should govern how information transfers between Marcus and me each week.

transcript.text: I should put a prior promise on the record. In a recent one-to-one with Elena, I informally committed to sending a written handoff checklist at least 24 hours before each weekly information transfer, and to holding one scheduled weekly coordination meeting. This commitment was never added to the case record, but it should govern our ongoing work arrangements.
